summary: Jianpu Technology filed a 6-K announcing that FINRA set October 20, 2026 as the ex-dividend date for its special cash dividend of US$0.02495 per ordinary share, equal to US$0.499 per ADS, previously announced September 2, 2026. Because the payout exceeds 25% of the ADS price, the ex-date follows the expected October 19, 2026 payment date and due-bill procedures apply, with broker-to-broker settlement and no company obligation. The US-equivalent disclosure is a foreign private issuer current report detailing a capital return; watch due-bill trading mechanics and post-distribution price adjustment risk.
